title: Open Forge workspace lock
description: Generated by Open Forge. Do not edit. Records which files the tool wrote, so removal and update know what they own. Each entry is a receipt taken when a verified mutation wrote the thing it names, not a projection of what a payload claims. A missing, stale, or unreadable lock is rebuilt best-effort and never refuses a command.

schemaVersion.description: The shape this file was written for. A version the CLI does not recognise is read for the keys it understands and reported, never refused.

extensions.description: One entry per installed Extension. A path owned by several Extensions is not recorded as shared; that is derived by intersecting these lists.

ownedPaths.description: Workspace-relative paths the CLI created in full. These may be deleted when nothing else owns them.

ownedRegions.description: Named regions the CLI generated inside files somebody else authored. These may be rewritten; the file holding them is never deleted.

region.description: The region marker name, such as "entries".

version.description: The release that wrote these entries. Compared by version alone; no payload hash is recorded, because the lock records ownership rather than integrity.

source.description: Where the Extension was installed from, such as "bundled" or an explicit source path.

paths.description: Source-relative eligible paths projected as leaf links beneath destinationRoot. Their workspace destinations combine destinationRoot with each path (or use the path directly when destinationRoot is .). Directories are not recorded, because detach does not remove them.
